notes:
{取|と}れる has multiple meanings: to come off, to be obtainable, or to be interpretable.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive) / potential of ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧
- Pair: ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (transitive, to take)

USAGE:
1. DETACHMENT: ⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れ→取る：00565_toru⟧た (button came off)
2. OBTAINABLE: ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れ→取る：00565_toru⟧た (got a reservation)
3. HARVEST: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{取|と}れる (vegetables can be harvested)
4. INTERPRETATION: 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{取|と}れる (can be interpreted as)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取る：00565_toru⟧: stain won't come off
- ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れ→取る：00565_toru⟧た: fatigue was relieved
- ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取る：00565_toru⟧: can't get time off

WATCH OUT:
⟦{撮|と}れる→撮れる：noentry⟧ (to be able to photograph) uses different kanji.
